title: A Detailed Factor Analysis for the Political Compass Test: Navigating Ideologies of Large Language Models
findings: The paper does not provide specific findings related to religion. The analysis focuses on aggregate 'social' and 'economic' scores derived from the Political Compass Test and 8 Values Test. The key findings are that these aggregate scores are sensitive to prompt phrasing and fine-tuning, but the paper does not analyze whether this sensitivity differs for religion-related questions versus other topics.
